protocol.observations: 8 x 5 x 5 local channels, no overhead state or agent ID
protocol.model: frozen categorical RSSM posterior + shared linear actor/critic
protocol.selection: highest validation mean per-agent alive-step return; earliest tie
protocol.final_role: report only after checkpoint selection is frozen
protocol.reward: 1 per agent remaining alive after each transition; zero on death

limitations: One training seed, bounded engineering run; no retention or generalization proof
Frozen small posterior and linear heads; incomplete Draft-2 model
Actual synthetic v2 browser rules; no learned-prior planning or recycling
Performance claims must compare all held-out references; trained does not imply improved
